<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1929776_compli_0.CPMPosture</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CPMPosture</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var CPMPosture = Class.create();
CPMPosture.prototype = {
  initialize: function() {
    this.util = new CPMUtil();
  },

  // Moves evidence through valid -> expiring -> expired. Reads only rows that can change today.
  rollStates: function() {
    var today = this.util.today();
    this._roll('valid', '<=', this.util.addDays(today, this.util.intProp('warning_days', 30)));
    this._roll('expiring', '<', today);
  },

  _roll: function(fromState, operator, date) {
    var record = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_control');
    record.addActiveQuery();
    record.addQuery('state', fromState);
    record.addQuery('valid_until', operator, date);
    record.query();
    while (record.next()) {
      var next = this.util.stateFor(record.getValue('valid_until'));
      if (next !== fromState) {
        record.setValue('state', next);
        record.update();
      }
    }
  },

  // Recalculates one service, or all of them when no id is given
  recalculate: function(serviceId) {
    var counts = this._collect(serviceId);
    var posture = new GlideRecord('x_1929776_compli_0_service_posture');
    if (serviceId) posture.addQuery('business_service', serviceId);
    posture.query();
    while (posture.next()) this._store(posture, counts[posture.getValue('business_service')] || {});
  },

  _collect: function(serviceId) {
    var counts = {};
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('x_1929776_compli_0_service_control');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addQuery('exempt', false);
    if (serviceId) ga.addQuery('business_service', serviceId);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.groupBy('business_service');
    ga.groupBy('state');
    ga.query();
    while (ga.next()) {
      var id = ga.getValue('business_service');
      counts[id] = counts[id] || {};
      counts[id][ga.getValue('state')] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
    }
    return counts;
  },

  _store: function(posture, counts) {
    var missing = counts.missing || 0, valid = counts.valid || 0;
    var expiring = counts.expiring || 0, expired = counts.expired || 0;
    var total = missing + valid + expiring + expired;
    var proven = valid + expiring;
    var coverage = total ? Math.round(proven / total * 100) : 0;
    var want = {
      total: total, proven: proven, expiring: expiring, expired: expired,
      missing: missing, coverage: coverage, risk: this.util.riskFor(total, coverage)
    };
    var changed = false;
    for (var field in want) {
      if ((posture.getValue(field) || '') !== String(want[field])) {
        posture.setValue(field, want[field]);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (changed) posture.update();
  },

  type: 'CPMPosture'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-24 11:48:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>a957f6ba73001310a621f2024ab8b734</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CPMPosture</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper" source="x_1929776_compli_0">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_a957f6ba73001310a621f2024ab8b734</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-24 11:48:49</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
